Platform Engineer

Harrowgate Freight moves refrigerated cargo across three countries, and the platform team keeps the systems that plan those movements running. We want a platform engineer who is happy owning a service end to end: the code, the queues behind it, the dashboards that say whether it is well, and the pager that rings when it is not.

Most of the work is in PHP against a Postgres database, with a scheduler that plans the next day's routes overnight. The planner is the part of the system people notice, so changes to it ship behind flags and are measured against the previous night's plan before they become the default. You would be the third engineer on that service.

The role is hybrid, two days a week in the depot office, and the team covers an on-call rotation one week in six. We will talk about what you have built, pair on a small change to our own planner, and introduce you to the planners who use it every morning.
